purpose: In-flow confirmation for reversible actions without modal interruption.
useWhen: Confirming a reversible action in the same flow as its trigger.

avoidWhen.reason: The action requires modal interruption or extensive consequences; use ConfirmDialog.

rationale: Nearest alternative: ConfirmDialog interrupts with a modal; this keeps confirmation in flow. The strip dismisses with a quiet icon-only X whose accessible name is cancelLabel, not visible text, so the confirm action is its one labelled button at the trailing edge.
